title: 3dretroicor
description: Performs Retrospective Image Correction for physiological motion effects using a modified RETROICOR algorithm

ignore.description: The number of initial timepoints to ignore in the input. These points will be passed through uncorrected.
ignore.title: Ignore

card.description: 1D cardiac data file for cardiac correction.
card.title: Cardiac data file

threshold.description: Threshold for detection of R-wave peaks in input. Make sure it's above the background noise level; try 3/4 or 4/5 times range plus minimum.
threshold.title: Threshold

order.description: The order of the correction. Higher-order terms yield little improvement according to Glover et al.
order.title: Order
